name: motion-parallax-layers
title: Parallax Layers
description: Ba lớp tiền cảnh, trung cảnh, hậu cảnh cùng trôi lên nhưng mỗi lớp một quãng khác nhau (40 / 25 / 10 px) để tạo chiều sâu.

moworks.author: takayu

options.unit: px per reference unit (5); each layer's travel in data-travel (40 / 25 / 10)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio parallax-layers, written here): 3 layers, all start together, 1.2 s linear (mapped to scroll progress): front y +18 → −22 px (40 px), middle +11 → −14 (25 px), back +4 → −6 (10 px). Demo loops the pass. Params: ids: trước → sau · travel ([40, 25, 10] px) · duration (1.2 s) · ease (none).
